subject: [RFC PATCH 16/18] mm/shmem: count accesses to a folio the way filemap_read() does

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the way access to shmem folios is counted, aligning it with how filemap_read() handles other files. Specifically, a read operation marks a folio as accessed unless it starts at the same position where the previous read ended. This change ensures that reads from the same bytes through one open file are only counted once, rather than each time they start at the beginning of the folio. Additionally, this patch sets PG_rcu_free on tmpfs folios that are repeatedly accessed and marks them as accessed even if a write operation is performed first.
